grill.definition: The part of a cooker that heats food from above, or to cook this way.

groom.definition: A man on his wedding day, or to clean an animal.

group.definition: A number of people or things together.

grouping.definition: A set of things put together by a shared quality.

guess.definition: To give an answer without being certain.

guidance.definition: Help and advice about what to do.

guide.definition: A person who shows the way, or a book with information.

guilt.definition: The feeling that you have done something wrong.

guilty.definition: Having done something wrong, or feeling shame about it.

gym.definition: A place with equipment for exercise, or physical education.

habitat.definition: The natural home of an animal or plant.

hammer.definition: A tool with a heavy head for hitting nails.

handball.definition: A game in which players throw a ball into a goal.

handle.definition: The part you hold, or to deal with something.

hang.definition: To fix something at the top so it hangs down.

hanging.definition: Something fixed so it hangs, or the act of killing by rope.

hardship.definition: A difficult situation with little money or comfort.

harness.definition: A set of straps for controlling an animal or holding a person.

hasty.definition: Done too quickly and without care.

hatch.definition: To break out of an egg, or a small door in a floor.

hatred.definition: An extremely strong feeling of dislike.

haunt.definition: To appear in a place as a ghost, or to worry you for a long time.

headline.definition: The title printed in large letters above a newspaper story.

heal.definition: To become healthy again after an injury.

healing.definition: The process of becoming healthy again.

hearing.definition: The ability to hear, or an official meeting.

hearted.definition: Having a certain kind of heart, as in kind-hearted.

hearty.definition: Loud and full of energy, or a big satisfying meal.

heat.definition: Warmth, or to make something warm.

heater.definition: A device that makes a room or water warm.

heaven.definition: The place where God lives, in many religions.

heavenly.definition: Coming from heaven, or extremely pleasant.

heel.definition: The back part of the foot.

height.definition: How tall something is, or how high it is.

helmet.definition: A hard hat that protects the head.

helpless.definition: Unable to do anything to help yourself.

herd.definition: A large group of animals that live together.

hesitate.definition: To pause before doing something because you are unsure.

hip.definition: The part of the body where the leg joins the side.

hire.definition: To pay to use something for a time, or to employ someone.

hit.definition: To strike with force, or a great success.

hiv.definition: A virus that damages the body's ability to fight illness.

hope.definition: To want something and believe it can happen.

hopeful.definition: Feeling that something good will happen.

hopeless.definition: With no hope, or very bad.

horizon.definition: The line where the sky seems to meet the land or sea.

horn.definition: A hard pointed growth on some animals' heads, or a device that makes a warning sound.

hostel.definition: A cheap place where travellers can sleep.

human.definition: A person, or belonging to people.

humanity.definition: All people together, or kindness towards others.

humid.definition: Having a lot of water in the air.

hunger.definition: The feeling that you need food.

hunt.definition: To chase animals to kill them, or to search for something.
